episode_summary: In this episode, Darwin Stephens shares his journey from corporate America to becoming a top luxury real estate agent. He emphasizes the importance of business acumen, personal branding, and leveraging technology to succeed in the luxury market. Darwin also discusses the value of networking and understanding client needs without assumptions.
